description: This file defines utility functions to create configuration objects for different sandbox setups, such as browser, prune, and SSH configs. It imports types from external modules and exports functions that generate configuration defaults with optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxBrowserConfig( createSandboxBrowserConfig
methods.description: Creates a default SandboxBrowserConfig object with optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxPruneConfig( createSandboxPruneConfig
methods.description: Creates a default SandboxPruneConfig object with optional overrides.

methods.name: export function createSandboxSshConfig( createSandboxSshConfig
methods.description: Creates a SandboxSshConfig object with specified workspaceRoot and optional overrides.
